text:
emma-sales: ok team — FinTrust signed the NDA and asked to start a perf POC next week. Requirements they gave: 1k concurrent users (chat API), ~60k tokens/min, p95 generation latency <300ms. They also want a short writeup at the end and answers to a security questionnaire. Can we run this on hosted for speed or do we need Dedicated?

raj-se: we can run a representative POC on hosted to prove perf quickly, but for sustained 1k concurrent with that token rate we'll need dedicated capacity to hit p95 targets reliably. propose 3-phase load plan below.

raj-se: PHASES:
- smoke (5-10m): sanity checks, auth, baseline throughput
- ramp (30-60m): linear ramp to target concurrency, observe kv cache/latency
- soak (1-2h): steady-state run to measure p95 and error patterns, capture traces

raj-se: quick k6 snippet for the ramp (pseudo):
```
import http from 'k6/http'
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: '...'}), {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer $POC_TOKEN'}})
}
```
Set vus to 1000 across 20 instances for ramp, capture client-side latency + our traces.

diana-lds: note on infra: if we do Hosted -> expect noisy neighbor variance. For final measurements and SLA demonstration we should run on a Dedicated subpool (2 x A100-equivalent nodes with optimized batching + kv caching). Also need VPC peering if they want Private.

emma-sales: @raj-se rough cost estimate for a 2-week POC (hosted vs dedicated) so finance can propose numbers? Also prospect wants simple pricing note for execs.

raj-se: hosted (two-week heavy tests + embeddings + guardrails): ~ $2k-$3k (mainly token usage + ephemeral infra). Dedicated reserved (1 month min to configure + test): baseline commit ~$11k/mo for that pool; POC discount possible — overage billed at usage rate. I'll add a final cost line in the writeup.

carlos-prospect: quick q — our production traffic is slightly bursty. Should you use synthetic load or replay? We can provide anonymized traces.

raj-se: replay is ideal (captures prefix lengths & real token distributions). If they can share a small, sanitized trace (1k sessions), we can run it in the ramp/soak. If not, synthetic with the same seq length distribution works.

olivia-ciso: security checklist items to flag: data residency, KMS support, audit logs, SOC2 report, and retention/deletion policy. Send the questionnaire to me and we'll mark which items are blockers. We will need a CLA for access to any production traces.

emma-sales: noted. @olivia-ciso i'll send questionnaire and the trace access request.

deploy-bot: test-environment provisioning started for POC: env-id=ft-poc-2026-03, expected ready in ~45m.

raj-se: suggested test metrics to capture and include in writeup:
- p50/p95/p99 generation latency (end-to-end)
- tokens/sec and tokens/min at client and server
- throughput (req/s) and success rate (%)
- GPU utilization, batch size distribution, KV cache hit rate
- memory/oom indicators and any error traces

raj-se: sample results section (placeholder):
"""
- target: 1k concurrent, 60k tok/min
- achieved steady-state: 950 rps equivalent, tokens/min = 58.3k
- p95 latency (end-to-end): 280ms
- error rate: 0.02% (transient 429s during ramp)
- avg GPU util: 72%, avg batch size: 12 tokens
"""
We'll include graphs and a short interpretation note.

diana-lds: add a short regression test: run a small golden prompt set before/after test to ensure quantization/peaks didn't regress output quality. We should include quality metrics (perplexity or eval prompts and pass/fail) in the writeup.

emma-sales: perfect. I'll schedule a 30m sync with FinTrust for Tues 11am PT to align on traces, success criteria, and sign-off on the load windows. Can we have a one-page PDF summary ready after the soak?

raj-se: yes — i'll produce a 1-page executive summary + full results appendix. Will include an appendix with pricing scenarios: Hosted short POC, Dedicated small reserved, Dedicated with burst buffer.

olivia-ciso: on the questionnaire: required doc we must provide asap = SOC2 type II PDF and our most recent penetration test summary. ops-team: does Redwood have a standard data deletion clause we can point to?

diana-lds: yes — standard retention: customer data processed for inference is ephemeral by default; logs and traces retained per customer agreement (default 30d). We have a deletion API and KMS integration. I'll paste the policy page link in the follow-up.

carlos-prospect: thanks — i can get a sanitized 1k-session trace exported by EOD. Also we prefer a dedicated-ish environment if possible for the soak.

emma-sales: thanks @carlos-prospect. Next steps: 1) raj to craft load plan + k6 script + cost ballpark (by EOD) 2) olivia to review questionnaire and flag blockers (by EOD) 3) deploy-bot will confirm env ready, then dry-run smoke tomorrow 10am PT 4) meeting Tues 11am PT to align.

raj-se: adding action: I'll attach the k6 script and a minimal results template to the Slack thread after I finish (will paste results template as code block).

emma-sales: awesome — appreciate it. :thumbsup: 

(organized by emma-sales)
